caption:
WD-40 literally names its 40th try. 🔧 Proof that the 'failed' attempts are part of the win. How many tries did your best thing take? 👇

Source: Wikipedia

post.news: Did you know? WD-40 means 'Water Displacement, 40th formula'. The first 39 didn't work.
